trade_lifetime_interpretation: Resolved trace only; lower bounds use all bars strictly before terminal bar plus recorded exit net; upper envelopes also include terminal OHLC, whose extrema may occur after exit. Never label the envelope as exact trade MFE/MAE.
forward_window_interpretation: Counterfactual 12-bar post-entry behavior, may continue after original exit; never call this actual trade-lifetime MFE or a new strategy return.
